2.0.0: added sqlite, better-sqlite3, mongodb, mysql and postgres support
added helper functions and removed $setVar, $getVar to secure better results
3.0.0: renamed to ReForgeDB (@tryforge/reforge.db, extension reforge.db); existing ForgeDB databases are used as they are
stored cooldowns work: $dbUserCooldown, $dbMemberCooldown, $dbGuildCooldown, $dbChannelCooldown (ForgeDB's never loaded, and failed on MySQL and PostgreSQL)
fixed empty ID fields, the user filter of $searchDB and $deleteRecords, channel leaderboard positions, leaderboard order with text values and ties
survives an unreachable database, reports errors that $try can catch, log levels up to every SQL statement
3 to 10 times faster writes, one scan per leaderboard command, optional read cache
3.1.0: a cooldown claim is one statement, whether it starts the cooldown or finds it running (two to start one on MySQL/MariaDB)
fixed: a claim that lost a race could report a cooldown as started that was not
tests for switching between sqlite and better-sqlite3, including both at once, crashes, locks and bad files
